# ADCIRC fort.15 문서–코드 대조

## 1 요약

주 대조 표는 358행을 판정했다. 불일치는 131행이다. 이 수는 독립 결함의 수가 아니다. 같은 결함에 해당하는 여러 매개변수 행을 각각 셌다.

아래 수는 2.1부터 2.6까지의 주 표, 2.8의 첫 매개변수 표, 2.10의 주 표에서 셌다. 자리별 분기 표와 기상 보충 형식 표는 중복 항목이므로 합계에서 제외했다. 반복 입력의 배열 원소는 한 행으로 셌다. 문서 별칭과 서로 다른 읽기 문맥의 기상 달력 필드는 표의 행 단위로 셌다.

| 주 표 | 전체 행 | 일치 | 불일치 | 문서에만 | 코드에만 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2.1 공통 위치 입력 | 70 | 47 | 23 | 0 | 0 |
| 2.2 기상 보충·ramp | 34 | 17 | 17 | 0 | 0 |
| 2.3 2D 출력 | 44 | 10 | 34 | 0 | 0 |
| 2.4 조화 분석·hot start·솔버 | 19 | 10 | 9 | 0 | 0 |
| 2.5 3D 위치·경계 | 35 | 16 | 17 | 2 | 0 |
| 2.6 3D 출력·metadata | 43 | 28 | 15 | 0 | 0 |
| 2.8 namelist | 108 | 41 | 13 | 1 | 53 |
| 2.10 추가 위치·문서 항목 | 5 | 0 | 3 | 1 | 1 |
| 합계 | 358 | 169 | 131 | 4 | 54 |

2.7의 기상 보충 표는 126행이다. 그 표의 불일치는 21행이다([10-10 검증 정정] NWS=6 계열 8행을 일치로 고쳤다. 원래 29행). 2.9의 AttrName 선택 표는 23개 이름을 대조했다. 그중 4개 이름의 문서 정의를 찾지 못했다. 3절의 문서 미정의 목록은 59개이다. 4절은 13개 노트 파일에 대한 수정안 29개를 담는다.

세부 주장 4개는 4절 마지막의 U01부터 U04까지에 판정 보류 이유를 적었다. 모델 실행·컴파일·수치 결과의 검증은 수행하지 않았다.


대상 코드는 ADCIRC v56.2.1이다. `models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/CMakeLists.txt:92`의 원문은 `set(ADCIRC_VERSION_STRING "v56.2.1")`이다.

판정은 지정된 원문을 `nl -ba`로 열어 수행했다. 판독 기록은 파일과 쟁점을 찾는 색인으로 사용했다. 현행 RST를 우선했다. 같은 내용의 위키는 중복 인용하지 않았다. v53 인용 행은 판 차이를 이유에 적었다. 인용한 ice PDF Marker의 `{5}`는 파일 쪽 6이다. PDF 인용은 파일 첫 쪽을 1로 계산한다.

`일치`는 인용한 의미·읽기 조건·선택이 모순되지 않는다는 판정이다. 문서가 적지 않은 검사와 기본값은 코드 열에 따로 적었다. 권고값은 생략 기본값이 아니다. `불일치`는 문서의 값·조건·순서·이름·기본값·기능과 코드가 다른 경우이다. `문서에만`은 활성 읽기가 없는 입력이다. `코드에만`은 검색한 문서에 해당 fort.15 입력 정의가 없는 항목이다.

읽기 통과는 물리 기능의 실행 검증이 아니다. 모델 실행과 컴파일을 수행하지 않았다. git을 사용하지 않았다. 다른 노트를 수정하지 않았다.


## 2 매개변수 대조 표

코드와 RST 링크의 `src/`와 `docs/` 기준 경로는 `models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/`이다. 모든 링크는 원문 줄을 가리킨다. 위치 입력은 해당 조건에서 필수이다. 위치 입력에는 입력 줄을 생략하는 기본값이 없다. 문서가 단위·허용 범위·기본값을 명시하지 않은 경우에는 그 값을 임의로 채우지 않았다. 개별 범위 검사의 부재는 읽기 루틴과 명시한 직접 연결 루틴에서 확인한 사실이다.

| ` NFOVER ` | 비치명 입력 오류 제어. 0=중단. 1=가능한 보정. 수위 한계를 사용하려면 DEBUG_WARN_ELEV 빌드가 필요하다고 적는다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:244](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:244) ` = 0, inconsistent input parameters will cause program termination. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:246](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:246) ` = 1, inconsistent input parameters will, (when possible), be automatically corrected to a default or consistent value and execution continued. Be sure to read the nonfatal warning messages to see whether any parameters have been modified. Note that not all inconsistent parameters can be corrected automatically and therefore fatal error messages and program termination may still result. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:250](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:250) ` Occasionally, the elevation solution becomes unphysically large due to improper numerical parameter settings, time step stability criteria violation. It can be useful for ADCIRC to terminate based on a user-specific limit to the computed water elevation. To enable this feature, ADCIRC must be compiled with the DEBUG_WARN_ELEV compiler directive. | ` NOLIBF ` | 2DDI 마찰 0=선형,1=제곱,2=혼합. 3D에서는 무시. Chezy/Manning/제곱 마찰 속성에는 반드시 1이며 다른 값이면 종료한다고 적는다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:387](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:387) ` Parameter controlling the type of bottom stress parameterization used in a 2DDI ADCIRC run. This parameter must be specified but is ignored in a 3D run. Note: In the NWP section, if the user selects quadratic_friction_coefficient_at_sea_floor, mannings_n_at_sea_floor, or chezy_friction_coefficient_at_sea_floor, then NOLIBF must be 1 (nonlinear friction formulation) since all those formulations are nonlinear. If the NOLIBF were anything other than 1, it is an error that will cause ADCIRC to stop. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:389](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:389) ` = 0 linear bottom friction law. The friction coefficient (FFACTOR) is specified below. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:391](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:391) ` = 1 quadratic bottom friction law. The friction coefficient (FFACTOR) is specified below. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:393](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:393) ` = 2 hybrid nonlinear bottom friction law. In deep water, the friction coefficient is constant and a quadratic bottom friction law results. In shallow water the friction coefficient increases as the depth decreases (e.g. as in a Manning-type friction law). The friction coefficient is determined as: FFACTOR=FFACTORMIN*[1+(HBREAK/H)**FTHETA]**(FGAMMA/FTHETA). The required parameters (FFACTORMIN, HBREAK, FTHETA, FGAMMA) are specified below. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:395](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:395) ` For 3D ADCIRC runs, spatially varying bottom friction should be specified using the bottom_roughness_length nodal attribute. `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/nolibf.rst:47](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/nolibf.rst:47) `` In the :ref:`NWP <nwp>` section, if the user selects ``<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/nolibf.rst:48](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/nolibf.rst:48) ` quadratic_friction_coefficient_at_sea_floor, mannings_n_at_sea_floor, or `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/nolibf.rst:49](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/nolibf.rst:49) ` chezy_friction_coefficient_at_sea_floor, then NOLIBF must be 1 (nonlinear `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/nolibf.rst:50](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/nolibf.rst:50) ` friction formulation) since all those formulations are nonlinear. The value of NOLIFA effects the meaning of the minimum water depth parameter(H0) and requires the specification of additional parameters together with H0, (see below). When the finite amplitude terms are turned on, the time derivative portion of the advective terms should also be turned on for proper mass conservation and consistency (i.e. when NOLIFA>0, then NOLICAT=1). `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:402](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:402) ` = 0 finite amplitude terms ARE NOT included in the model run (i.e., the depth is linearized by using the bathymetric depth, rather than the total depth, in all terms except the transient term in the continuity equation) and wetting and drying of elements is disabled. Initial water depths are assumed equal to the bathymetric water depth specified in the grid file (fort.14). `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:404](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:404) ` = 1 finite amplitude terms ARE included in the model run and wetting and drying of elements is disabled. Initial water depths are assumed equal to the bathymetric water depth specified in the grid file (fort.14). `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:406](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:406) ` = 2 finite amplitude terms ARE included in the model run and wetting and drying of elements is enabled. | ` NRAMP ` | 0..8의 램프 선택. RST 형식은 0/1에도 DRAMP 줄을 적는다. 위키는 NRAMP>0일 때만 그 줄을 넣으라고 적는다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:471](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:471) ` = 0 No ramp function is used with forcing functions; full strength forcing is applied immediately upon cold start. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:473](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:473) ` = 1 A single hyperbolic tangent ramp function of specified duration (DRAMP, in days relative to the cold start time) will be applied to all forcing. See description of the DRAMP line for further information on the ramp function. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:475](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:475) ` = 2 Same as NRAMP=1, except that a second, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPExtFlux, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for external flux forcing (e.g., river boundary conditions) will also be read on the DRAMP line. In addition, the FluxSettlingTime parameter for IBTYPE=52 river boundaries will also be specified on the DRAMP line. If there are no IBTYPE=52 boundaries in the mesh (fort.14) file, the FluxSettlingTime will be read but ignored. See description of DRAMP for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:477](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:477) ` = 3 Same as NRAMP=2, except that a third, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPIntFlux, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for internal flux forcing (e.g., flows over levees and under culverts) will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:479](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:479) ` = 4 Same as NRAMP=3, except that a fourth, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPElev, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for elevation specified boundary forcing (e.g., tidal boundaries) will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:481](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:481) ` = 5 Same as NRAMP=4, except that a fifth, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPTip, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for tidal potential forcing will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:483](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:483) ` = 6 Same as NRAMP=5, except that a sixth, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPMete, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for meteorological forcing (i.e., wind and atmospheric pressure) will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:485](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:485) ` = 7 Same as NRAMP=6, except that a seventh, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPWRad, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for wave radiation stress forcing will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:487](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:487) ` = 8 Same as NRAMP=7, except that a delay parameter (DUnRampMete, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) will also be read from the DRAMP line. The meteorological ramp delay parameter DUnRampMete is useful in cases where a meteorologically-forced run will be hotstarted from a long term meteorologically-free tidal spinup from cold start. The meteorological ramp delay parameter delays the start of the application of the meteorological ramp for the specified length of time, relative to the ADCIRC cold start time. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. | ` G ` | 중력 가속도. 시간 s. 길이는 Cartesian 좌표 단위. 비Cartesian/조석/Coriolis 조건의 요구값은 9.81 m/s²이다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:492](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:492) ` Gravitational constant. The units of this constant determine the distance units that ADCIRC operates with. (ADCIRC always operates in seconds and therefore the time units for G must be seconds.) When ICS = 2, it is required that G = 9.81 m/sec2. Regardless of ICS, when either NTIP = 1 or NCOR = 1, it is required that G = 9.81 m/sec2. ` | 항상 읽는다. 비Cartesian에서 9.81과의 절대 차이가 0.01보다 크면 종료한다.<br>[src/read_input.F:2480](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2480) ` READ(15,*) G `<br>[src/read_input.F:2481](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2481) ` IF((ICS.NE.1).AND.(abs(G-9.81).gt.0.01)) THEN `<br>[src/read_input.F:2487](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2487) ` WRITE(16,5) G ` | 일치 | 9.81은 문서 요구값이다. 코드의 0.01 허용 오차를 입력 기본값으로 해석하지 않았다. |
| ` TAU0 ` | GWCE 가중과 음수 옵션. 양수 상수, -1/-2/-3/-5/-6/-7, 소수 첫 자리 1의 출력을 설명한다. 인용한 정의 값표는 단위를 명시하지 않는다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:497](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:497) ` Generalized Wave-Continuity Equation (GWCE) weighting factor that weights the relative contribution of the primitive and wave portions of the GWCE. If "primitive_weighting_in_continuity_equation" is specified as a nodal attribute in the fort.15 file above, this line will be read in but ignored. If a nodal attribute file is not used or "primitive_weighting_in_continuity_equation" is in the nodal attribute (fort.13) file, but not specified in the fort.15 file this TAU0 parameter will be used. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:499](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:499) ` = 0 the GWCE is a pure wave equation. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:501](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:501) ` < 1 the GWCE behaves like a pure primitive continuity equation. A good rule of thumb for setting TAU0 is to set it equal to the largest value of an equivalent linear friction factor (e.g, for linear friction TAU0 = TAU; for quadratic friction TAU0 = maximum (speed*CF/depth). Typical values for TAU0 are in the range of 0.005 – 0.1. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:503](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:503) ` = -1 the TAU0 is spatially varying but constant in time; it is calculated according to depth as follows: If the depth is >=10 TAU0 is set to 0.005, if the depth is < 10, TAU0 is set to 0.020. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:505](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:505) ` = -2 the TAU0 is spatially varying but constant in time; it is calculated according to depth as follows: if the depth is >=200 TAU0 is set to 0.005, if the depth is < 200 but > 1, then TAU0 is set to 1/depth, and if depth < 1, TAU0 is set to 1.0. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:507](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:507) ` = -3 the TAU0 varies spatially and in time. TAU0 is computed from TAU0Base read in from nodal attribute file. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:509](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:509) ` if TAU0Base < 0.025; TAU0 = TAU0Base (constant in time) `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:511](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:511) ` if TAU0Base >= 0.025; TAU0 = TAU0Base + 1.5 TK(i) where TK(i)=Cd\\|U\\|/H `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:521](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:521) ` = -5, FullDomainTimeVaryingTau0 = .True. the TAU0 varies spatially and in time, and is dependent on the local friction; it is limited to a range specified by Tau0FullDomainMin and Tau0FullDomainMax. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:525](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:525) ` For tau0 formulations that vary spatially and temporally, ADCIRC is capable of writing out the tau0 values that it calculates internally. These values are written to a fort.90 file, which has the same format and output frequency as the water surface elevation output file (fort.63). The production of a fort.90 file is specified by placing a 1 in the tenths place of the tau0 input valuie in the fort.15 file. For example, if tau0=-3.1, the calculation of tau0 is still carried out according to the description of tau0=-3 above, and the fort.90 output file will also be produced. `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:169](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:169) ``` -  ``TAU0 = -3, -6, or -7``, :math:`\tau_0` varies in time and based on ```<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:182](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:182) `` A positive value is ignored if the :ref:`primitive weighting in continuity ``<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:188](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:188) `` GWCE is a pure wave equation for :math:`\tau_0=0`, and approaches a pure ``<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:189](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:189) `` primitive equation as :math:`\tau_0\rightarrow\infty`, however in practice, it ``<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:190](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:190) `` behaves like a pure primitive equation once :math:`\tau_0` reaches 1 or so. ``<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:204](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/model_parameters/tau0.rst:204) ``` -  ``If depth >= 10; TCM V49.64.01 ADDITIONS FOR ICE CONCENTRATION `<br>[src/read_input.F:2601](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2601) ` IF((NCICE.EQ.0).AND.(NRS.EQ.0)) READ(15,*) NWLAT,NWLON,WLATMAX, `<br>[src/read_input.F:2602](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2602) ` &        WLONMIN,WLATINC,WLONINC,WTIMINC `<br>[src/read_input.F:2603](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2603) ` IF((NCICE.EQ.0).AND.(NRS.GE.1)) READ(15,*) NWLAT,NWLON,WLATMAX, ! sb46.28sb03 `<br>[src/read_input.F:2604](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2604) ` &        WLONMIN,WLATINC,WLONINC,WTIMINC,RSTIMINC ` | 불일치 | 정의 문서가 NWS=7 계열의 격자 입력을 빠뜨린다. 증가량의 양수 조건은 해당 READ에서 검사하지 않는다. |
| ` YYYY ` | 연도 입력. 와류 자료에서 t=0에 대응하는 cold start 달력.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:569](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:569) ` For the Dynamic Holland model (NWS=8) and the Dynamic Asymetric Model (NWS=19), this is the coldstart datetime, the number of the storm in forecast ensemble, and the boundary layer adjustment factor. The datetime tells ADCIRC what time corresponds to t=0. For example, if the datetime is specified as 2005 08 29 06 on a cold start, then ADCIRC will find that time in the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File, linearly interpolating if necessary, to get its initial wind state. For a hotstart, the time in the hotstart file will be added to this datetime before seeking the proper place in the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File. For example, if the coldstart datetime is still specified as 2005 08 29 06, and the time in the hotstart file is 86400 seconds, ADCIRC will start up and interpolate in the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File for the conditions at 6:00 am on August 30, 2005 to get its hotstart wind state. One limitation is that an ADCIRC run cannot cross the boundary of the calendar year, i.e. start in December and end in January. StormNumber is an integer and should be set to 1. BLAdj is the adjustment factor between wind speed at 10m and the wind speed at the top of the atmospheric boundary layer (winds at top of atm. b.l.)=(winds at 10m)/BLAdj. Reasonable range is 0.7 to 0.9. `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/moteorological_parameter_line.rst:741](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/moteorological_parameter_line.rst:741) ``` - ``YYYY`` ``MM`` ``DD`` ``HH24`` ``StormNumber`` ``BLAdj`` ``geofactor`` ``pureVortex`` ``pureBackground`` ``` | IREFYR/IREFMO/IREFDAY/IREFHR로 읽는다. | ` HH24 ` | 시 입력. 와류 자료에서 t=0에 대응하는 cold start 달력.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:569](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:569) ` For the Dynamic Holland model (NWS=8) and the Dynamic Asymetric Model (NWS=19), this is the coldstart datetime, the number of the storm in forecast ensemble, and the boundary layer adjustment factor. The datetime tells ADCIRC what time corresponds to t=0. For example, if the datetime is specified as 2005 08 29 06 on a cold start, then ADCIRC will find that time in the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File, linearly interpolating if necessary, to get its initial wind state. For a hotstart, the time in the hotstart file will be added to this datetime before seeking the proper place in the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File. For example, if the coldstart datetime is still specified as 2005 08 29 06, and the time in the hotstart file is 86400 seconds, ADCIRC will start up and interpolate in the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File for the conditions at 6:00 am on August 30, 2005 to get its hotstart wind state. One limitation is that an ADCIRC run cannot cross the boundary of the calendar year, i.e. start in December and end in January. StormNumber is an integer and should be set to 1. BLAdj is the adjustment factor between wind speed at 10m and the wind speed at the top of the atmospheric boundary layer (winds at top of atm. b.l.)=(winds at 10m)/BLAdj. The core of a tropical cyclone is represented using the GAHM model and read in from a file named NWS_20_fort.22, which should be created following the procedure presented in the section on NWS=20. The user must also supply gridded wind and pressure files in the form of an OWI-style fort.22 file, a fort.221 file, and a fort.222 file, details on these are in the section on NWS=12. ADCIRC internally blends the wind and pressure fields from these two sets of inputs over a user-controlled distance. Specifically, the pureVortex and pureBackground inputs in the fort.15 file (for formatting, see info on the meteorological parameter line) are coefficients used to define where transitions between the vortex and background meteorology occur. At or within the distance pureVortex*vortexRMW of the storm's center, the GAHM meteorology is used. At or beyond the distance pureBackground*vortexRMW of the storm's center, the background meteorology is used. In between these, a linear distance-weighted average of the two sets of meteorology is used to define the forcing. ` | ABS(NWS)=29/30에서 읽는다. 초기값은 0이지만 활성 분기에서 필수 입력으로 덮어쓴다.<br>[src/wind.F:112](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/wind.F:112) ` ! radial extent of unblended vortex winds, normalized to current Rmax `<br>[src/wind.F:113](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/wind.F:113) ` REAL(8) :: pureVortex = 0.0d0 `<br>[src/read_input.F:2748](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2748) ` READ(15,*) IREFYR,IREFMO,IREFDAY,IREFHR,StormNumber,BLAdj, `<br>[src/read_input.F:2749](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2749) ` &                  WTIMINC, pureVortex, pureBackground `<br>[src/read_input.F:2762](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2762) ` READ(15,*) IREFYR,IREFMO,IREFDAY,IREFHR,StormNumber,BLAdj, `<br>[src/read_input.F:2763](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2763) ` &          GEOFACTOR, WTIMINC, pureVortex, pureBackground ` | 일치 | 의미가 일치한다. | ` DRAMP ` | 공통 ramp 기간. 단위 일. 문서 식은 IT*DTDP를 사용한다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:631](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:631) ` Value (in decimal days) used to compute the ramp function that ramps up ADCIRC forcings from zero (if NRAMP=1). IBTYPE=52가 없으면 read but ignored.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:475](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:475) ` = 2 Same as NRAMP=1, except that a second, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPExtFlux, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for external flux forcing (e.g., river boundary conditions) will also be read on the DRAMP line. In addition, the FluxSettlingTime parameter for IBTYPE=52 river boundaries will also be specified on the DRAMP line. STATIM=10에서 11을 넣으면 1일 뒤이다. 경과 일수 1을 넣으면 변환은 -9일이다. 문서의 경과 시간 표현과 다르다. |

### 2.5 3D 위치 입력과 baroclinic 경계 입력

| 항목 | 문서: 의미·허용값·기본값·단위·읽기 조건과 원문 | 코드: 읽기·검사·기본값·오류 처리와 원문 | 판정 | 이유 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ` IDEN (3D 확인 블록) ` | 모든 3D run에서 다시 입력한다. 첫 IDEN과 같은 밀도 방식이다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:125](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:125) ` **[The following information is only included for a 3D run:]** `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:126](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:126) `` :ref:`IDEN <IDEN>` ``<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:355](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:355) ` = 21 Baroclinic 3D run using New GWCE and velocity based Momentum equations `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:357](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:357) ` = 111112 Barotropic 2DDI run using the lumped GWCE (instead of the default fully consistent GWCE). This option is needed to run ADCIRC in lumped + explicit mode, thereby bypassing the iterative solver. Explicit mode also requires specifying coefficients A00, B00, C00 (= 0, 1, 0) in this file. (see below) `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:359](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:359) ` = 611112 Barotropic 3D run using the lumped GWCE (instead of the default fully consistent GWCE). This option is needed to run ADCIRC in lumped + explicit mode, thereby bypassing the iterative solver. Explicit mode also requires specifying coefficients A00, B00, C00 (= 0, 1, 0) in this file. In this case, RBCTIMEINC, SBCTIMEINC (levels of no motion and salinity boundary time interval), BCSTATIM and SBCSTATIM (starting time for the level of no motion and salinity boundary condition information) are needed. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1629](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1629) ` RES_BC_FLAG = 3 Prognostic simulation using temperature field, so the boundary conditions utilize both the levels of no motion (steric adjustments to the elevations found in fort.35) and the temperature field of the outside ocean (found in fort.37). In this case, RBCTIMEINC, TBCTIMEINC (levels of no motion and temperature boundary time interval), BCSTATIM and TBCSTATIM (starting time for the level of no motion and temperature boundary condition information) are needed. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1631](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1631) ` RES_BC_FLAG = 4 Prognostic simulation using both salinity and temperature fields, so the boundary conditions utilize the levels of no motion (steric adjustments to the elevations found in fort.35), and the salinity field and the temperature field of the outside ocean (found in fort.36 and fort.37, respectively). In this case, RBCTIMEINC, SBCTIMEINC, TBCTIMEINC, BCSTATIM, SBCSTATIM and TBCSTATIMare needed. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:157](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:157) ` **[The following line will be read in if IM is 21 or 31.]** `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:158](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:158) `` :ref:`RES_BC_FLAG <RES_BC_FLAG>`, :ref:`BCFLAG_LNM <BCFLAG_LNM>`, :ref:`BCFLAG_TEMP <BCFLAG_TEMP>` `` | CBaroclinic이면 읽는다. | ` BCFLAG_LNM ` | 1=fort.35. 2=not valid. 3=초기 수위. 파일 형식은 IM=21/31에서 줄을 요구한다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1637](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1637) ` Flag to control the levels of no motion parameterization used in the 3D ADCIRC run. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1639](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1639) ` BCFLAG_LNM = 1 Levels of no motion are elevations provided from a file (fort.35) and that file is accessed based on RBCTIMEINC. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1641](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1641) ` BCFLAG_LNM = 2 Not a valid value. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1643](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1643) ` BCFLAG_LNM = 3 Levels of no motion are elevations provided from the initial values of the elevations. RES_BC_FLAG=3/4 외에는 ignored.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1688](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1688) ` Controls the surface heat flux parameterization used in the 3D ADCIRC simulation with temperature. ADCIRC ignores this parameter unless RES_BC_FLAG is 3 or 4. Currently, there are three options for the surface heat flux boundary (all surface heat flux values are read in from a fort.38 file). `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1690](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1690) ` BCFLAG_TEMP = 1 Surface heat flux values are directly provided from a file (fort.38), and that file is accessed based on TTBCTIMEINC (surface heat flux boundary time interval) and starts reading the values based on TTBCSTATIM (starting time for the surface heat flux boundary condition information). `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1692](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1692) ` BCFLAG_TEMP = 2 Surface heat flux values are calculated from information obtained from a file (fort.38), and that file is accessed based on TTBCTIMEINC and starts reading the values based on TTBCSTATIM. This option looks for 6 values (sensible heat flux, latent heat flux, downward shortwave radiation, downward longwave radiation, upward shortwave radiation, upward longwave radiation) to use in calculating the surface heat flux from the following equation (Mellor, 1996): qh = qs + ql + (Sraddown – Sradup) + (lraddown – lradup) where qs = sensible heat flux, ql = latent heat flux, sraddown=downward shortwave radiation, sradup=upward shortwave radiation, lraddown=downward longwave radiation, lradup=upward longwave radiation. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1694](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1694) ` BCFLAG_TEMP = 3 Surface heat flux values are calculated from information obtained from a file (fort.38), and that file is accessed based on TTBCTIMEINC and starts reading the values based on TTBCSTATIM. This option looks for 4 values (net shortwave radiation, net longwave radiation, latent heat flux, sensible heat flux,) to use in calculating the surface heat flux from the following equation (Mellor, 1996): qh = qs + ql + Sradnet + lradnet where qs = sensible heat flux, ql = latent heat flux, sradnet=net shortwave radiation, lradnet=net longwave radiation. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:157](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:157) ` **[The following line will be read in if IM is 21 or 31.]** `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:158](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:158) `` :ref:`RES_BC_FLAG <RES_BC_FLAG>`, :ref:`BCFLAG_LNM <BCFLAG_LNM>`, :ref:`BCFLAG_TEMP <BCFLAG_TEMP>` ``<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:171](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:171) ` **[The following two lines will be read in if RES_BC_FLAG = 3 or 4 and BCFLAG_TEMP is not equal to 0.]** ` | CBaroclinic에서 읽는다. ABS(RES_BC_FLAG)=3/4 AND BCFLAG_TEMP!=0이면 시간 두 값을 추가로 읽는다. READ는 BCFLAG_TEMP 범위를 검사하지 않는다. BCFLAG_TEMP=2의 열 flux 식은 첫째 sensible와 둘째 latent 항을 뺀다. read in from file with 4 components `<br>[src/cstart.F:925](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:925) ` READ(38,*) (NOD,(TMP(K,J),J=1,4),K=1,NP) `<br>[src/cstart.F:927](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:927) ` q_heat1(NumofNodes)=TMP(NumofNodes,4)+ `<br>[src/cstart.F:928](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:928) ` &              TMP(NumofNodes,3)-TMP(NumofNodes,1)+ `<br>[src/cstart.F:929](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:929) ` &              TMP(NumofNodes,2) ` | 불일치 | 코드는 음수 -3/-4에서도 시간 줄을 소비한다. 문서의 ignored 조건과 다르다. 문서의 열 flux 합 식과 코드 식의 부호가 다르다. 입력 자료의 물리적 부호 규약은 판정 보류 목록에 적었다. |
| ` SPONGEDIST ` | wind와 advection의 공간 ramp 거리. 중력과 같은 길이 체계 m 또는 ft. !=0 AND NOUTGE!=0이면 fort.92를 만든다고 적는다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1699](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1699) ` Controls the sponge layer that allows for a spatial ramp to occur on the wind and advection terms, but it does not vary in time. It starts at zero on the boundary and linearly increases to one over a user-defined distance into the domain. The distance must be given in either m or ft, depending on the units on gravity. The sponge layer is utilized for both the diagnostic and prognostic simulations for the wind terms and all advective terms (momentum and transport equations, if applicable). If SPONGEDIST is not equal to zero, and NOUTGE is not equal to zero, ADCIRC will produce a fulldomain output file that shows the extent of the sponge layer (similar in format to the maxele.63 file) called fort.92. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:174](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:174) ` **[The following two lines will be read in only if IM is 21 or 31.]** `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:175](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort15.rst:175) `` :ref:`SPONGEDIST <SPONGEDIST>` `` | CBaroclinic에서 읽는다. SPONGEDIST>=0이면 OUTPUTSPONGE를 켠다. 초기 ASCII 전역 수위 출력 경로가 OUTPUTSPONGE를 검사한다.<br>[src/read_input.F:5637](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:5637) ` IF (CBAROCLINIC) THEN `<br>[src/read_input.F:5638](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:5638) ` READ(15,*) SPONGEDIST `<br>[src/read_input.F:5641](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:5641) ` IF (SPONGEDIST.GE.0.d0) THEN `<br>[src/read_input.F:5642](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:5642) ` OUTPUTSPONGE=.TRUE. `<br>[src/cstart.F:485](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:485) ` IF((ABS(NOUTGE).EQ.1).OR.(ABS(NOUTGE).EQ.4)) THEN `<br>[src/cstart.F:490](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:490) ` IF (OUTPUTSPONGE) THEN ` | 불일치 | 문서의 !=0과 플래그의 >=0이 다르다. 파일 형식이 IM=21/31로 조건을 한정한다. |
| ` EQNSTATE ` | 1=선형 상태 방정식. 2=McDougall. 3=UNESCO. 2/3은 IDEN=±4에서 사용한다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1704](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1704) ` Indicates the equation of state used to convert the salinity and temperature values into density values. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1706](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1706) ` EQNSTATE = 1 Use the equation of state given in Cushman-Roisin, B., Introduction to Geophysical Fluid Dynamics, Prentice-Hall, 1994, 320 pp. (1994): rho = rho0 (1 – alpha(T-T0)+beta(S-S0)) where rho0=1028 kg/m3 is the reference density of seawater, alpha=0.00017/degC is the coefficient of thermal expansion, and beta=0.00076 is the coefficient of saline concentration. The reference values for temperature and salinity are: T0=10 degC and S0=35 psu. This option can be used for IDEN=2, -2, 3, -3, 4 or -4. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1708](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1708) ` EQNSTATE = 2 Use the equation of state given in McDougall, T. J., D.G. Wright, D. R. Jackett and R. Feistel, "Accurate and computationally efficient algorithms for potential temperature and density of seawater", Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology, 20 (5), 2003, pp. 730-741. This uses the temperature, salinity and pressure in determining the density field. This option can be used when IDEN = 4 or -4. The equation used with this option can be found in the theory manual. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1710](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1710) ` EQNSTATE = 3 Use the equation of state is the UNESCO equation and is given in Gill, A.E., Atmosphere-Ocean Dynamics, Academic Press, 1982, 662 pp. and Mellor, G.L., Introduction to Physical Oceanography, American Institute of Physics, 1996, 284 pp. It uses the temperature, salinity and pressure in determining the density field. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1712](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1712) ` This option can be used when IDEN = 4 or -4. ### 2.7 NWS의 모든 허용 검사와 보충 줄 형식

이 절은 NWS 행의 세부 판정이다. 1절의 매개변수 행 수에 이 절을 다시 더하지 않았다. 모든 기상 표 행을 원문 순서대로 대조했다. 얼음 숫자를 분리한 뒤 허용 검사를 수행한다. 그 다음 파랑 숫자를 분리한다. 예시 표에 없는 음수·NRS=2/5·NCICE=10/14/17도 코드 분기 표에 포함했다.

| 항목 | 문서: 의미·허용값·기본값·단위·읽기 조건과 원문 | 코드: 읽기·검사·기본값·오류 처리와 원문 | 판정 | 이유 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ` NWS 부호 확장 ` | NWS 문서는 일부 부호 조합만 설명한다.<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:308](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:308) ` **NWS = 13, -13** `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:311](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:311) ` **NWS = 14, -14** `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:325](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:325) ` Hurricane parameters are read in from the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File. It is assumed that the line in the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File with a zero as the forecast increment (i.e., column 6) corresponds to the start of the current simulation run, whether it is a hotstart or cold start. In other words, there is no option to set the NWS value negative to indicate that the file starts at the ADCIRC hotstart time. Rather, the forecast increment in hours (column 6) is used to indicate the relationship between the ADCIRC time and the data in the fort.22 file. `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:331](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:331) ` In order to use the NWS=19 option, the file needs to be in best track format. The forecast period (column #6) needs to be edited to reflect the time of the forecast/nowcast for each track location (each line) in hours from the start of the simulation (0, 6, 12, 18, etc). There is no -19 option to indicate that the hours in column 6 are relative to the hotstart time. For the dynamic asymmetric model (NWS=19), ADCIRC always assumes that hour 0 corresponds to when the model is started, whether that is a cold start or a hot start. Therefore, ADCIRC analysts should not attempt to set NWS to -19.  The original data in that column depends on what type of best track format data is being used. The original data might have 0 or other numbers in that column. See: http://www.nrlmry.navy.mil/atcf_web/docs/database/new/abrdeck.html ` | allowable_nws의 모든 값에 NRS=0–5를 더하고 양·음수 모두 허용 검사한다. -1/-3/-6/-10/-11에는 보충 입력 READ 분기가 없다. -17은 ABS READ 분기는 있지만 NUOPC 기상 플래그는 +17에서만 켠다.<br>[src/read_input.F:1782](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:1782) ` do i=0,5 `<br>[src/read_input.F:1783](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:1783) ` if ( any(nws.eq.(allowable_nws + i*100)).or. `<br>[src/read_input.F:1784](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:1784) ` &        any(nws.eq.(-1*(allowable_nws + i*100))) ) then `<br>[src/read_input.F:1829](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:1829) ` NRS=ABS(NWS/100) `<br>[src/read_input.F:1830](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:1830) ` NWS=(ABS(NWS)-NRS*100)*(NWS/ABS(NWS)) `<br>[src/read_input.F:2300](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2300) ` IF(NWS.EQ.17) THEN `<br>[src/read_input.F:2301](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2301) ` NUOPC4MET = .TRUE.  !TODO: to do this here or inside the CAP `<br>[src/read_input.F:2562](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2562) ` IF((NWS.EQ.0).AND.(NRS.GE.1)) READ(15,*) RSTIMINC ! sb46.28sb03 `<br>[src/read_input.F:2563](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2563) ` IF((NWS.EQ.1).AND.(NRS.GE.1)) READ(15,*) RSTIMINC ! sb46.28sb03 `<br>[src/read_input.F:2568](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2568) ` IF(NWS.EQ.3) THEN `<br>[src/read_input.F:2600](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:2600) ` C... | ` NWS=-14 ` | GRIB2/NetCDF의 hotstart 시간 기준이라고 설명한다.<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:311](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:311) ` **NWS = 14, -14** `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:312](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:312) ` Wind velocity and atmospheric pressure are read in from NetCDF or GRIB2 format files. This option allows ADCIRC to directly read standardized meteorological formats. If NWS = 14, ADCIRC assumes data from the cold start time; if NWS = -14, ADCIRC assumes data from the hot start time. The files must include wind velocity components and sea level pressure on a regular grid with proper metadata. `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/wtiminc.rst:19](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/wtiminc.rst:19) | ` NWS=±19 ` | 문서는 -19 옵션이 없다고 적는다.<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:325](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:325) ` Hurricane parameters are read in from the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File. It is assumed that the line in the Single File Meteorological Forcing Input File with a zero as the forecast increment (i.e., column 6) corresponds to the start of the current simulation run, whether it is a hotstart or cold start. In other words, there is no option to set the NWS value negative to indicate that the file starts at the ADCIRC hotstart time. Rather, the forecast increment in hours (column 6) is used to indicate the relationship between the ADCIRC time and the data in the fort.22 file. `<br>[docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:331](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/user_guide/model_configuration/meteorological_forcing/nws_parameters.rst:331) ` In order to use the NWS=19 option, the file needs to be in best track format. The forecast period (column #6) needs to be edited to reflect the time of the forecast/nowcast for each track location (each line) in hours from the start of the simulation (0, 6, 12, 18, etc). There is no -19 option to indicate that the hours in column 6 are relative to the hotstart time. For the dynamic asymmetric model (NWS=19), ADCIRC always assumes that hour 0 corresponds to when the model is started, whether that is a cold start or a hot start. Therefore, ADCIRC analysts should not attempt to set NWS to -19.  The original data in that column depends on what type of best track format data is being used. The original data might have 0 or other numbers in that column. Another commonly used value is 0.002. ` | REAL(8) 기본값 0.0035. 해당 READ는 범위를 검사하지 않는다. 계산한 drag가 한계를 넘으면 cap을 적용한다. 일반 namelist 오류 처리는 2.8.1에 적었다.<br>[src/read_input.F:242](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:242) ` NAMELIST /metControl/ WindDragLimit,DragLawString,outputWindDrag, `<br>[src/read_input.F:499](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:499) ` read(unit=15,nml=metControl,iostat=ios,iomsg=ios_nml_error_msg) `<br>[src/wind.F:122](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/wind.F:122) ` REAL(8) :: WindDragLimit = 0.0035d0   ! maximum wind drag value `<br>[src/wind.F:788](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/wind.F:788) ` IF(WindIceDrag.gt.WindDragLimit) WindIceDrag=WindDragLimit ` | 일치 | 입력 의미와 읽기 조건이 모순되지 않는다. 문서가 적지 않은 기본값과 검사는 코드 열에 적었다. |
| ` metControl.DragLawString ` | 문서는 기본 Garratt를 적는다. 얼음에서는 IceCube(default) 또는 RaysIce 설정을 허용한다고 적는다.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:2864](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:2864) ` This character string controls the formulation used to calculate the nodal wind drag coefficients on the water surface from the nodal wind speed. The default value "Garratt" specifies the formula WindDragCoefficient = 0.001d0 * (0.75d0 + 0.067d0 * WindSpeed). Alternatively, for tropical cyclones, setting the 'DragLawString' equal to "Powell" causes a more complex formulation to be used, where different formulas apply to different storm quadrants. If ice coverage data have been specified via appropriate specification of the NWS parameter, the wind drag coefficient formulation can also be set to IceCube (the default) or RaysIce. Complete details are available in the documentation of the Ice Coverage Input Files (fort.25, fort.225, fort.227). `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort25.rst:7](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort25.rst:7) ` When using ice fields, the wind drag coefficient is first computed by the usual Garratt formula based on wind speed, then a wind drag coefficient is computed by a new function called IceCube that is based solely on the percent of ice coverage, then the maximum of the Garratt and IceCube drag coefficients is taken but must still be less than or equal to the drag cap in ADCIRC. If there is no ice in a particular area, then the drag coefficient is the same as Garratt. ` | 기본 'default'. POWELL 빌드에서는 'Powell'로 바꾼다. 초기화는 Garratt/GARRATT/garratt/default와 Powell/POWELL/powell을 받는다. CSWAN이면 Swell/SWELL/swell도 받는다. NWS!=0의 다른 문자열은 종료한다. 얼음 계산 함수의 default/Powell은 Lupkes 방식이다. 일반 namelist 오류 처리는 2.8.1에 적었다.<br>[src/read_input.F:242](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:242) ` NAMELIST /metControl/ WindDragLimit,DragLawString,outputWindDrag, | ` wetDryControl.outputNodeCode ` | TRUE이면 nodecode.63을 켠다. 기본 FALSE. fort.63과 같은 일정.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:2954](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:2954) ` Logical variable activates the production of the nodecode.63 file for nodal wet/dry state when set to '.true.'. The default value is '.false.'. The nodecode.63 output file is produced in ASCII format with the same structure as the fort.63 file (with the exception that the node code value is an integer) and on the same schedule as the fort.63 file. A nodal value of 1 in the nodecode.63 file indicates that the node is wet on the timestep that the data set was written, while a value of 0 indicates that the node is dry on the timestep that the data set was written. In order to be included in the computations of water surface elevation and velocity, a node must be wet. ` | LOGICAL 기본 FALSE. nodecode.63 출력 제어. 일반 namelist 오류 처리는 2.8.1에 적었다.<br>[src/read_input.F:246](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:246) ` NAMELIST /wetDryControl/ outputNodeCode, outputNOFF, `<br>[src/read_input.F:638](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:638) ` read(unit=15,nml=wetDryControl,iostat=IOS,iomsg=ios_nml_error_msg) `<br>[src/write_output.F:337](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/write_output.F:337) ` logical :: outputNodeCode = .false. ` | 일치 | 입력 의미와 읽기 조건이 모순되지 않는다. 문서가 적지 않은 기본값과 검사는 코드 열에 적었다. |
| ` wetDryControl.outputNOFF ` | TRUE이면 noff.100을 켠다. 기본 FALSE. fort.63과 같은 일정.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:2959](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:2959) ` Logical variable activates the production of the noff.100 file for elemental wet/dry state when set to '.true.'. The default value is '.false.'. The noff.100 output file is produced in ASCII format with a structure similar to the fort.63 file, with the following exceptions: (a) the noff value is an integer; and (b) the noff array is elementally based, so the number of values for each time snap is equal to the number of elements, rather than the number of nodes. When outputNOFF is set to .true., the noff.100 file will be produced on the same schedule as the fort.63 file. An elemental value of 1 in the noff.100 file indicates that the element is wet on the timestep that the data set was written, while a value of 0 indicates that the element is dry on the timestep that the data set was written. In order to be included in the computations of water surface elevation and velocity, an element and all three of its nodes must be wet. ` | LOGICAL 기본 FALSE. noff.100 출력 제어. 일반 namelist 오류 처리는 2.8.1에 적었다.<br>[src/read_input.F:246](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:246) ` NAMELIST /wetDryControl/ outputNodeCode, outputNOFF, `<br>[src/read_input.F:638](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:638) ` read(unit=15,nml=wetDryControl,iostat=IOS,iomsg=ios_nml_error_msg) `<br>[src/write_output.F:338](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/write_output.F:338) ` logical :: outputNOFF = .false. ` | 일치 | 입력 의미와 읽기 조건이 모순되지 않는다. 문서가 적지 않은 기본값과 검사는 코드 열에 적었다. |

Due to the sparse nature of the weir height output data, sparse ASCII format (nout_TVW=4) is recommended. If use_TVW is set to .true. but this parameter nout_TVW is not set at all, then nout_TVW is set to the same value as the file format specifier for the fort.63 file (NOUTGE). Since ADCIRC normally requires 10 minute averaged winds, many of ADCIRC's meteorological reading subroutines also include a conversion from the time averaging period of the source data (if such time averaging is a standard for that data type) to a 10 minute average. #### 2.8.1 namelist의 검색 순서와 오류 처리

ADCIRC의 명령줄 처리 뒤 READ_INPUT 호출이 이 읽기 경로에 들어간다. READ_INPUT은 INPUTDIR의 fort.15를 연다. 코드는 위치 입력을 읽기 전에 각 namelist를 검색한다. 코드는 검색 사이에 rewind를 수행한다. 전통 위치 입력은 마지막 namelist 검색 뒤 RUNDES부터 읽는다. namelist는 문서 요구에 따라 파일 끝에 둔다. 아래 순서는 코드의 검색 순서이다. 첫 namelist 매개변수 표의 108행만 1절의 namelist 행 수에 포함했다.

The value of NOLIFA effects the meaning of the minimum water depth parameter(H0) and requires the specification of additional parameters together with H0, (see below). When the finite amplitude terms are turned on, the time derivative portion of the advective terms should also be turned on for proper mass conservation and consistency (i.e. when NOLIFA>0, then NOLICAT=1). `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:402](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:402) ` = 0 finite amplitude terms ARE NOT included in the model run (i.e., the depth is linearized by using the bathymetric depth, rather than the total depth, in all terms except the transient term in the continuity equation) and wetting and drying of elements is disabled. Initial water depths are assumed equal to the bathymetric water depth specified in the grid file (fort.14). `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:404](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:404) ` = 1 finite amplitude terms ARE included in the model run and wetting and drying of elements is disabled. #### NOLIFA·NOLICA·NOLICAT 조합

아래 결과는 NOLIFA의 사전 보정 뒤 값이다. NFOVER!=1 열은 0을 포함한다. NOLIFA>=1 AND NOLICAT=0 경고·종료 블록은 주석이다. NOLIFA=0 AND NOLICAT=1 검사와 NOLICA!=NOLICAT 검사는 활성이다.

| NOLIFA | NOLICA | NOLICAT | NFOVER!=1 | NFOVER=1 | 활성 조건 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 통과 | 통과 | 활성 불일치 검사 없음 |
| 0 | 0 | 1 | 종료 | 경고 후 값 변경 없이 통과 | NOLIFA=0 AND NOLICAT=1; NOLICA!=NOLICAT |
| 0 | 1 | 0 | 종료 | 경고 후 값 변경 없이 통과 | NOLICA!=NOLICAT |
| 0 | 1 | 1 | 종료 | 경고 후 값 변경 없이 통과 | NOLIFA=0 AND NOLICAT=1 |
| 1 | 0 | 0 | 통과 | 통과 | 활성 불일치 검사 없음 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 종료 | 경고 후 값 변경 없이 통과 | NOLICA!=NOLICAT |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | 종료 | 경고 후 값 변경 없이 통과 | NOLICA!=NOLICAT |
| 1 | 1 | 1 | 통과 | 통과 | 활성 불일치 검사 없음 |
| 2 | 0 | 0 | 통과 | 통과 | 활성 불일치 검사 없음 |
| 2 | 0 | 1 | 종료 | 경고 후 값 변경 없이 통과 | NOLICA!=NOLICAT |
| 2 | 1 | 0 | 종료 | 경고 후 값 변경 없이 통과 | NOLICA!=NOLICAT |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 통과 | 통과 | 활성 불일치 검사 없음 |

| 항목 | 문서: 의미·허용값·기본값·단위·읽기 조건과 원문 | 코드: 읽기·검사·기본값·오류 처리와 원문 | 판정 | 이유 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ` 조합 검사 원문 ` | 각 항의 0/1 뜻.<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:422](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:422) ` Parameter controlling the time derivative portion of the advective terms that occurs in the GWCE form of the continuity equation in ADCIRC. The remainder of the advective terms in the GWCE and the entire advective terms in the momentum equation are controlled by NOLICA. If "primitive_weighting_in_continuity_equation" is specified as a nodal attribute in the fort.15 file above, this line will be read in but ignored. If a nodal attribute file is not used or "primitive_weighting_in_continuity_equation" is in the nodal attribute (fort.13) file, but not specified in the fort.15 file this TAU0 parameter will be used. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:499](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:499) ` = 0 the GWCE is a pure wave equation. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:501](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:501) ` < 1 the GWCE behaves like a pure primitive continuity equation. See description of the DRAMP line for further information on the ramp function. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:475](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:475) ` = 2 Same as NRAMP=1, except that a second, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPExtFlux, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for external flux forcing (e.g., river boundary conditions) will also be read on the DRAMP line. In addition, the FluxSettlingTime parameter for IBTYPE=52 river boundaries will also be specified on the DRAMP line. If there are no IBTYPE=52 boundaries in the mesh (fort.14) file, the FluxSettlingTime will be read but ignored. See description of DRAMP for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:477](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:477) ` = 3 Same as NRAMP=2, except that a third, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPIntFlux, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for internal flux forcing (e.g., flows over levees and under culverts) will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:479](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:479) ` = 4 Same as NRAMP=3, except that a fourth, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPElev, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for elevation specified boundary forcing (e.g., tidal boundaries) will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:481](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:481) ` = 5 Same as NRAMP=4, except that a fifth, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPTip, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for tidal potential forcing will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:483](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:483) ` = 6 Same as NRAMP=5, except that a sixth, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPMete, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for meteorological forcing (i.e., wind and atmospheric pressure) will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:485](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:485) ` = 7 Same as NRAMP=6, except that a seventh, separate hyperbolic tangent ramp of specified duration (DRAMPWRad, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) specifically for wave radiation stress forcing will also be read on the DRAMP line. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:487](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:487) ` = 8 Same as NRAMP=7, except that a delay parameter (DUnRampMete, in days relative to cold start time plus FluxSettlingTime) will also be read from the DRAMP line. The meteorological ramp delay parameter DUnRampMete is useful in cases where a meteorologically-forced run will be hotstarted from a long term meteorologically-free tidal spinup from cold start. The meteorological ramp delay parameter delays the start of the application of the meteorological ramp for the specified length of time, relative to the ADCIRC cold start time. See the description of the DRAMP line for further information. #### NWP에서 요청하는 AttrName의 모든 선택

다음 이름은 fort.13 값을 fort.15에서 사용하겠다는 선택이다. 이 표는 AttrName 허용 이름을 대조한다. fort.13의 모든 값·단위·공간 파일 형식을 재감사하는 표가 아니다. 이름 비교는 대소문자를 구분한다. 알 수 없는 이름은 메시지를 출력한다. 해당 CASE DEFAULT에는 terminate 호출이 없다.

## 3 코드에만 있는 입력

이 목록은 2절의 항목을 다시 모았다. 문서 부재 검사는 전체 RST 150개, 위키 Markdown 161개, v53 Markdown 75개, PDF Marker 초안 42개, PDF 판독 기록 124개를 대상으로 수행했다. 수는 파일 검색 목록에서 산출했다. 이름 검색은 대소문자를 구분하지 않았다. 현재 노트는 문서 원문으로 세지 않았다. 소스 판독 기록도 문서 정의로 세지 않았다.

namelist 선언 변수 107개 중 53개는 이름 검색에서 문서가 없었다. 그 53개 안에는 실제 이름 WaveWindMultiplier가 포함된다. nws08Control.WindMultiplier의 동명 검색 결과는 fort.16의 GFDL fort.22 설명이었다. 따라서 fort.15 입력 정의로 세지 않았다. 이 표에는 미정의 namelist 입력 54개, 관측소 선택 토큰 1개, AttrName의 미정의 허용 이름 4개를 적었다. 총 59개이다. WaveWindMultiplier는 2절에서 불일치로 판정했다. 나머지 변수의 코드에만 판정은 54개이다. AttrName 네 이름은 허용값 판정이다.

부재 판정은 보관한 지정 문서의 검색 결과이다. 해석: 변수의 철자를 적지 않은 설명만으로 namelist의 정확한 이름·형식을 정의했다고 볼 수 없다. NWP의 일반 설명이 추가 AttrName의 정확한 이름을 정의한 것도 아니다.

## 4 노트 대조와 수정안

다음 표는 현재 노트의 관련 원문과 수정안을 담는다. 고칠 원문은 노트 파일의 실제 줄이다. 새 문장은 제안이다. 노트 파일은 수정하지 않았다. 수정안 수는 이 표의 C01부터 C29까지 센 29개이다. 대상 노트 파일 수는 중복 경로를 제외한 13개이다. C24는 오류 판정이 아닌 조건 명시 보완안이다.

| 번호 | 현재 노트: 파일·줄과 고칠 원문 | 대조 결과 | 새 문장 | 수정안의 출처 원문 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C01 | [models/ADCIRC/source-analysis/adcirc-parameter-glossary-v1.md:58](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/source-analysis/adcirc-parameter-glossary-v1.md:58) `` - 수심이 얕을수록 높은 값 사용이 공식 값표에 내장 (`tau0.rst:204-214`: `TAU0=-1` → depth≥10 에서 0.005, depth<10 에서 0.020; `TAU0=-2` → depth≥200 에서 0.005, 1<depth<200 에서 1/depth, depth<1 에서 1) — 이전 판의 익명 'FAQ guidance' 인용을 공식 문서로 대체 `` | 수심 10의 코드 경계가 문서와 다르다. 수심 1의 문서 조건이 빠졌다. | 현행 RST는 TAU0=-1의 depth>=10에 0.005를 적는다. v56.2.1 코드는 Depth.LE.10.에 0.020d0을 대입한다. #### 판정하지 못한 세부 주장

주 표의 입력 읽기 판정과 아래 세부 주장의 보류를 구분한다. 아래 4개는 코드 실행 결과의 추정으로 채우지 않았다.

| 번호 | 대상 | 판정하지 못한 이유 | 확인한 원문 |
|---|---|---|---|
| U01 | tau0_gen.f의 TAU0Base 생성 규칙 | 지정한 src/prep/wind/util의 파일명과 소스 검색에서 tau0_gen.f를 찾지 못했다. 절점 간격 1750 m와 수심 10 m의 유틸리티 판정은 대조하지 못했다. | [docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:513](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:513) ` TAU0Base values can be generated with the ADCIRC utitlity program tau0_gen.f. The program bases generation on the following logic: `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:515](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:515) ` If the avg. distance between a node and its neighbors < 1750 m TAU0Base = 0.03 `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:517](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:517) ` If the avg. distance between a node and its neighbors > 1750 m AND depth < 10m; TAU0Base = 0.02 `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:519](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:519) ` If the avg. distance between a node and its neighbors > 1750 m AND depth > 10m; TAU0Base = 0.005 ` |
| U02 | TAU0 일반 정의의 < 1 문장 | 원문은 < 1이라고 적는다. 코드는 TAU0>=0을 절점 값으로 대입한다. 이 읽기는 pure primitive의 물리적 크기 기준을 검사하지 않는다. 해당 문장의 물리적 기준 판정은 보류했다. | [docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:499](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:499) ` = 0 the GWCE is a pure wave equation. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:501](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:501) ` < 1 the GWCE behaves like a pure primitive continuity equation. A good rule of thumb for setting TAU0 is to set it equal to the largest value of an equivalent linear friction factor (e.g, for linear friction TAU0 = TAU; for quadratic friction TAU0 = maximum (speed*CF/depth). Typical values for TAU0 are in the range of 0.005 – 0.1. `<br>[src/nodalattr.F:1909](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/nodalattr.F:1909) ` IF (.not.LoadTau0) THEN `<br>[src/nodalattr.F:1910](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/nodalattr.F:1910) ` IF (Tau0.ge.0) THEN `<br>[src/nodalattr.F:1912](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/nodalattr.F:1912) ` Tau0Var(I)=Tau0 ` |
| U03 | NCDATE의 시간대 접미부 처리 | 코드는 %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S로 strptime을 부른다. 시간대 접미부의 수용 여부는 strptime과 isvalid의 내부 동작에 의존한다. 해당 외부 라이브러리 내부는 지정 코드 범위 밖이다. | [src/read_input.F:4804](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:4804) ` READ(15,'(A80)',err=99999,end=99998,iostat=ios) base_date `<br>[src/read_input.F:4806](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:4806) ` #ifdef DATETIME `<br>[src/read_input.F:4808](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:4808) ` basedatetime = strptime(adjustl(trim(base_date)), `<br>[src/read_input.F:4809](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:4809) ` &                           "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") `<br>[src/read_input.F:4811](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:4811) ` if (.not.basedatetime%isvalid()) then `<br>[src/read_input.F:4812](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:4812) ` call terminate(exit_code=ADCIRC_EXIT_FAILURE,message='Invalid base datetime: ' `<br>[src/read_input.F:4814](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/read_input.F:4814) ` &           //'. Must be formatted as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') ` |
| U04 | BCFLAG_TEMP=2/3 열 flux 식의 물리적 부호 규약 | 문서 식과 코드 식의 부호 차이는 확인했다. fort.38 설명은 각 입력 성분의 방향별 부호 규약을 정의하지 않는다. 어느 식이 실제 forcing 공급 자료에 맞는지 판정하지 못했다. | [docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1692](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1692) ` BCFLAG_TEMP = 2 Surface heat flux values are calculated from information obtained from a file (fort.38), and that file is accessed based on TTBCTIMEINC and starts reading the values based on TTBCSTATIM. This option looks for 6 values (sensible heat flux, latent heat flux, downward shortwave radiation, downward longwave radiation, upward shortwave radiation, upward longwave radiation) to use in calculating the surface heat flux from the following equation (Mellor, 1996): qh = qs + ql + (Sraddown – Sradup) + (lraddown – lradup) where qs = sensible heat flux, ql = latent heat flux, sraddown=downward shortwave radiation, sradup=upward shortwave radiation, lraddown=downward longwave radiation, lradup=upward longwave radiation. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1694](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/parameter_definitions/index.rst:1694) ` BCFLAG_TEMP = 3 Surface heat flux values are calculated from information obtained from a file (fort.38), and that file is accessed based on TTBCTIMEINC and starts reading the values based on TTBCSTATIM. This option looks for 4 values (net shortwave radiation, net longwave radiation, latent heat flux, sensible heat flux,) to use in calculating the surface heat flux from the following equation (Mellor, 1996): qh = qs + ql + Sradnet + lradnet where qs = sensible heat flux, ql = latent heat flux, sradnet=net shortwave radiation, lradnet=net longwave radiation. `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort38.rst:44](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort38.rst:44) ` - For BCFLAG_TEMP=2 and 3: `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort38.rst:45](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort38.rst:45) ` - TMP(K,J) represents the Jth heat flux component for the Kth horizontal mesh node `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort38.rst:47](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort38.rst:47) ` - BCFLAG_TEMP=2 requires 6 heat flux components `<br>[docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort38.rst:48](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/docs/technical_reference/input_files/fort38.rst:48) ` - BCFLAG_TEMP=3 requires 4 heat flux components `<br>[src/cstart.F:907](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:907) ` q_heat1(NumofNodes)=-TMP(NumofNodes,1)- `<br>[src/cstart.F:908](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:908) ` &              TMP(NumofNodes,2)+TMP(NumofNodes,3)- `<br>[src/cstart.F:909](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:909) ` &              TMP(NumofNodes,5)+TMP(NumofNodes,4)- `<br>[src/cstart.F:910](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:910) ` &              TMP(NumofNodes,6) `<br>[src/cstart.F:927](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:927) ` q_heat1(NumofNodes)=TMP(NumofNodes,4)+ `<br>[src/cstart.F:928](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:928) ` &              TMP(NumofNodes,3)-TMP(NumofNodes,1)+ `<br>[src/cstart.F:929](/home/firesinger/coastal-wiki/models/ADCIRC/raw/source_code/adcirc/src/cstart.F:929) ` &              TMP(NumofNodes,2) ` |
